ifuto-armor-hud.join_notice: §7[Armor HUD]§r You can tweak everything from the Config screen added by the Mod Menu mod (toggle HUD with V)
ifuto-armor-hud.config.title: Ifuto Armor HUD Settings
ifuto-armor-hud.config.hint: Default key: V — show or hide the HUD
ifuto-armor-hud.config.show_hud.tooltip: Shows or hides the whole HUD (the V key also toggles it).
ifuto-armor-hud.config.position.tooltip: Which side of the hotbar the panel sits on.
ifuto-armor-hud.config.layout.tooltip: Whether the slots stack vertically or sit in a row.
ifuto-armor-hud.config.background.toolti: Frame: a vanilla slot frame (resource-pack friendly). Icons: no frame, empty slots only show a white icon of what goes there.
ifuto-armor-hud.config.empty.tooltip: What to do with slots that have nothing equipped.
ifuto-armor-hud.config.hotbar_gap.toolti: Distance from the hotbar (7 px matches the offhand slot).
ifuto-armor-hud.config.slot_gap.tooltip: Space between slots. 0 gives the seamless hotbar frame; anything else gives the rounded offhand frame.
ifuto-armor-hud.config.inside.tooltip: What to show at the bottom inside the slot (where the gauge goes).
ifuto-armor-hud.config.outside.tooltip: Horizontal: text above the slot (gauge unavailable). Vertical: beside the slot; the gauge stands upright. The gauge hides while durability is full.
ifuto-armor-hud.config.outside_side.tool: For the vertical layout: which side of the slots shows the outside info. Pointing it toward the hotbar doubles as natural padding.
ifuto-armor-hud.config.warn_blink.toolti: Smoothly pulses a red border when a piece drops below the threshold.
ifuto-armor-hud.config.warn_percent.tool: Used by both the blink and the "Critical" show condition.
Draws a soft shadow behind text and gauges so they stay readable on bright backgrounds.
ifuto-armor-hud.config.client_id.placeho: Used when the packet has no client ID (blank = off)
ifuto-armor-hud.config.client_id.tooltip: When the server sends ifumods:server/discord, its text is shown as your Discord status. The packet normally carries its own client ID; this field is the fallback for when it doesn't.
ifuto-armor-hud.config.show_condition.to: Critical: only shows the HUD while some armor is at or below the blink threshold.
ifuto-armor-hud.config.break_alert.toolt: Plays a sound and a chat message the moment an armor piece breaks.
ifuto-armor-hud.config.hud_scale.tooltip: Scales the whole HUD around the corner nearest the hotbar.
